We focus on morphological inflection, which has been featured in recent work on auxiliary task training. Furthermore, it is a character-level task with small models that maintains relevance even in the age of LLMs, due to its potential to aid language documentation efforts.
datasets: SIGMORPHON 2022 morpheme segmentation shared task data
languages: 19 languages (e.g., English, Hungarian, Italian, Russian, Spanish, etc.)
outputs: inflected word forms given a lemma and morphological tags, e.g., f(try, PST) → tried
